reviewer: AI visual review; not independent human ground truth

label_policy.WAIT: Hands outside the tabletop, or resting at its edge without task-tool/workpiece handling. Edge means immediately adjacent to the perimeter; an arm reaching inward is not edge-only WAIT.
label_policy.PASSTHRU: Hands or arms farther into the tabletop workspace without task-tool/workpiece handling, whether moving or stationary.
label_policy.INTERACTION: Task-tool handling or workpiece manipulation/stabilization; takes precedence over edge location.

policy_authority: User update: edge hands WAIT; farther onto table PASSTHRU. Task interaction remains INTERACTION.
boundary_method: Qualitative visible table perimeter; no calibrated pixel polygon or physical-width threshold supplied. Borderline edge/interior transitions remain excluded.
integration_note: Segment manifest only. Enforce ranges or materialize trimmed folders before training. Keep every segment from one source trial in its original split.
excluded_frames: Unlisted frames remain unassigned; this is a conservative selection, not exhaustive dense labeling. Do not infer their class from the source trial label.
frame_window_note: 8 fps is sampling rate. Current code defaults to 16 frames per window but supports 8. Both length flags are descriptive, not model or dataset requirements. No defaults changed.
